Friends User:

So, when I was in an instance Inviting my friends and they join I don't see them at the spawn area I couldn't see them at all, and I know my friends are calling my username, but I cannot hear them when I look at my menu and check it says they are already in the instance, and I was so confuse where they at, and after when they change their avatar boom now I can see them it feels like my friends have me block but is a weird glitch that I couldn't see my friends when they join the instance and when they change avatar their avatar they appear out of nowhere.

Random User:

So, when I was just chilling around the map, and I was just sitting there doing nothing and after when I just realize I saw a random object floating right there moving and when I thought that user block me, I pull out my, admin panel and click on the top trigger I could not find the user hit box the hit box was just not there it just a floating object moving around the map after when I try to find who is this user that is grabbing an random objects I couldn't find the user in the instance and I don't know there username but they are there they are in a instance they don't have me block I don't have them block and after when they change their avatar boom they appear out of nowhere I can now finally see the user that is holding an object that user did not have me block it was just a weird glitch that happen to so many people in the instance and this happen to people and me all days and I still don't know what is causing this glitch to happen.

To those people that did happen to them:

If this glitch did actually happen to you then you did find a suggested post that did happen to you In VRChat random instance if you're an admin of those worlds' same thing.
